class.name: ACTelemetry
class.brief_description: Interface for Assetto Corsa telemetry data acquisition via shared memory.
class.description:
[ACTelemetry] manages real-time telemetry data from Assetto Corsa. It provides functionality to connect to the game, log telemetry snapshots during gameplay, and load previously recorded sessions.
The class uses Windows shared memory to access physics, graphics, and static data from Assetto Corsa. Telemetry snapshots are collected at configurable intervals and can be saved to binary files for later analysis.
[b]Note:[/b] This class is Windows-specific and requires Assetto Corsa to be running.

method.name: connect_to_ac
method.description: Establishes a connection to Assetto Corsa via shared memory. Attempts to open file mappings for physics, graphics, and static data. Returns an empty string on success, or an error message describing the failure if connection cannot be established.

method.name: disconnect_from_ac
method.description: Closes all shared memory connections to Assetto Corsa and releases associated resources. Safe to call even if not connected.

method.name: start_logging
method.description: Begins recording telemetry snapshots. Clears any previously recorded data and resets the session state.

method.name: finish_logging
method.description: Stops logging and writes all recorded telemetry data to a binary file at the specified path. Supports Godot path aliases ([code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code]) which are automatically converted to filesystem paths. Returns the filesystem path on success, or an error message if the operation fails.

method.name: get_live_static_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing static track and car information from the current live session. The dictionary includes car model, track name, player details, vehicle specifications, and session configuration. Returns an empty dictionary if not actively logging.

method.name: load_session_data
method.description: Loads telemetry data from a previously saved session file. Supports Godot path aliases ([code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code]) which are automatically converted to filesystem paths. Returns an empty string on success, or an error message if the file cannot be read or is invalid.

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_data
method.description: Returns an array of telemetry snapshots for the specified lap from a loaded session. The [param lap_index] parameter is zero-indexed. Returns an empty array if the lap index is out of bounds.

method.name: get_loaded_session_static_data
method.description: Returns a dictionary containing the static data (track info, car specs) from the loaded session. Returns an empty dictionary if no session has been loaded.

method.name: get_loaded_session_lap_count
method.description: Returns the total number of laps in the loaded session.

method.name: get_loaded_session_sample_interval
method.description: Returns the sampling interval (in seconds) used when the session was recorded.

method.name: is_connected_to_ac
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if currently connected to Assetto Corsa via shared memory.

method.name: is_currently_logging
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if telemetry recording is currently active.

method.name: close_loaded_session
method.description: Closes the currently loaded session data and releases associated resources. Safe to call even if no session is loaded.

signal.name: connection_lost
signal.description: Emitted when the connection to Assetto Corsa is unexpectedly lost during an active logging session.
